title: Frequency-Domain FIR Filter
text: Filter input signal in the frequency domain, 3 inputs, no direct feedthrough, {Frequency response} sets Frequency response of filter; {Frequency-domain filter method} sets the filtering method in frequency domain, {Numerator domain}, {Specify coefficients from input port} sets the flag to specify time-domain FIR filter, {Filter coefficients} sets the time-domain FIR filter coefficients fir1, {Specify frequency response from input port} sets the flag to specify frequency-domain filter, {Number of propagation paths}, {Sum filtered output contributions from all input channels} sets the option to sum filtered output contributions from all input, {Partition numerator to reduce latency} sets the option to partition the numerator to reduce, {Numerator partition length} sets the partition length of numerator, {Time-domain numerator length}, {Inherit FFT length from numerator length} sets the flag to inherit FFT length from the numerator, {FFT length}, {Filter is real} sets the flag to specify if filter is real, {Output filter latency} sets the flag to output filter latency, {View Filter Response} sets the visualize frequency response and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Num
ports.summary: Time-domain FIR filter coefficients row vector | matrix (since R2024a)

ports.name: NumFFT
ports.summary: Frequency-domain FIR filter coefficients row vector | matrix | 3-D array (since R2024a)

ports.name: output
ports.summary: Filtered output vector | matrix | 3D array (since R2024a)

params.name: Frequency-domain filter method
params.values: Filtering method in frequency domain Overlap-save (default) | Overlap-add

params.name: Specify coefficients from input port
params.values: Flag to specify time-domain FIR filter coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Filter coefficients
params.values: Time-domain FIR filter coefficients fir1(100,0.3) (default) | row vector | matrix (since R2024a)

params.name: Specify frequency response from input port
params.values: Flag to specify frequency-domain filter coefficients off (default) | on

params.name: Frequency response
params.values: Frequency response of filter fft(fir1(100,0.3),202) (default) | row vector | matrix | 3-D array (since R2024a)

params.name: Number of propagation paths
params.values: Number of propagation paths between each input channel and output channel pair 1 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Sum filtered output contributions from all input channels
params.values: Option to sum filtered output contributions from all input channels true (default) | false

params.name: Partition numerator to reduce latency
params.values: Option to partition the numerator to reduce latency off (default) | on

params.name: Numerator partition length
params.values: Partition length of numerator 32 (default) | positive integer

params.name: Inherit FFT length from numerator length
params.values: Flag to inherit FFT length from the numerator length on (default) | off

params.name: Filter is real
params.values: Flag to specify if filter is real true (default) | false

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
